name: soterai-ide-guard
displayName: SoterAI IDE Guard — Local AI Security
description: Protect secrets, prompts, MCP tools, terminal commands, and AI coding context locally before they reach AI.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: SoterAI IDE Guard runs all secret/PII/prompt-injection scanning fully locally, so scanning works in restricted mode. Cloud connection, token storage, and remote scan escalation are disabled in untrusted workspaces until you trust the workspace.

soterai.cloud.enabled.description: Enable cloud features like policy sync and high-risk cloud scan escalation.

soterai.scan.remoteEscalation.description: Escalate high-risk scanning to cloud (redacted/minimized payload only).

soterai.privacyMode.description: Controls whether SoterAI uses only local detectors, configured cloud checks, or local-first hybrid checks with user consent.

soterai.sensitiveContext.defaultAction.description: Default action when sensitive context is selected for AI use.

soterai.sensitiveContext.allowRawReveal.description: Allow dangerous reveal-once flows after explicit confirmation. Enterprise policy can still disable this.

soterai.sensitiveContext.requireApproval.description: Require user approval before brokered local actions can use a secret reference.

soterai.sensitiveContext.ttlMinutes.description: Maximum lifetime for scoped secret references.

soterai.audit.storeRawPrompts.description: Store raw prompts in the audit ledger. This should remain disabled for privacy.

soterai.scan.maxFileSizeKb.description: Maximum file size to scan locally in KB.

soterai.scan.maxWorkspaceFiles.description: Maximum files to check during workspace security scans.

soterai.scan.excludeGlobs.description: Exclude glob patterns from file scans.

soterai.broker.openAIProviderUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible upstream chat completions endpoint. Stored locally.

soterai.broker.anthropicProviderUrl.description: Anthropic-compatible upstream messages endpoint. Stored locally.

soterai.terminal.protectionMode.description: Action on detecting dangerous terminal commands.

soterai.terminal.warnOnRawTerminalOpen.description: Show a one-time warning when a raw VS Code terminal opens because raw terminal input is outside SoterAI broker enforcement. The warning offers the broker-controlled terminal route.

soterai.sentinel.enabled.description: Enable AI Activity Sentinel background monitor.

soterai.protectedWorkspace.enabled.description: Enable Protected Workspace Mode — auto-protect sensitive files.

soterai.mcpFirewall.strictMode.description: Enable strict MCP Tool Firewall — block unknown tools.

soterai.showAllCommands.description: Show all ~100 advanced SoterAI commands in the Command Palette. Off by default keeps the palette focused on the core commands; every command remains available from the SoterAI Guard view, status bar, and this setting.

soterai.experimentalFeatures.enabled.description: Show Labs and experimental SoterAI commands in the Command Palette. Keep this off for the stable marketplace experience.

soterai.liveScan.enabled.description: Scan supported files as you type and show secrets, PII, prompt-injection, and jailbreak risks inline (squiggly underlines with lightbulb Quick Fixes). 100% local regex/heuristic detection — nothing is sent anywhere. This is VISIBILITY_ONLY: diagnostics appear after content exists; SoterAI does not block other extensions or prevent you from sending text to AI.

soterai.protection.enabled.description: Enable the central SoterAI protection state. This does not imply universal interception; coverage is reported from verified runtime facts.

soterai.sentinel.retentionDays.description: Local Sentinel metadata/redacted-evidence retention period. Raw prompts and secrets are not retained.

soterai.dependencyGuard.osvMode.markdownDescription: How Dependency Guard obtains CVE advisories. `ask` prompts before contacting [OSV](https://osv.dev) (`api.osv.dev`); `always` queries OSV online (package name + version only); `never` uses local heuristics only (typosquat, unpinned, remote URL, install scripts). **Advisory only** — cannot block installs outside SoterAI-reviewed commands. SoterAI is not a full SCA product; OSV is the advisory source when online.
